review.scope: One answer to the exact Patch-shape question and the terminal fixed-Commit admission result; no consent for future contact.
review.requestQuote: Which shape does the catalog prefer?

responseBody:
Thanks for explaining that both entries come from the same package. The Catalog answer is option 1: keep the two rows and their separate entry IDs. The fixed manifest exports `./gate` to `./lib/gate.js`; the Store contract now checks that each inserted name resolves to the reviewed package, requires a matching root entry in the same Patch, and accepts only an exact safe export target.

Formal fixed-source decision: **admitted**. `dsh-model-everything` 0.1.0 is recorded as `approved` under manual review at Commit `77ba449060adb6e80de554b52ec1e90845c9e780`. The complete bounded source (108 files, 1,909,622 bytes) was hash-checked; no unsupported files or static security findings were observed.

The DSH install/boot/tool-call evidence in your repository remains author-provided; DSH STORE did not install or run the plugin, so Store-side installability and runtime acceptance remain unknown. Full fixed-source evidence and the contract change are recorded at https://github.com/AI-Scarlett/DSH-Store/blob/main/docs/reviews/external-review-20261019.md. This reply addresses your specific question and this admission result only; future versions need a new fixed-Commit review request. The Issue remains open.
